name: Embraer 170 (E170-100)

reference.wingtip: Small blended winglet (tall, narrow, near-vertical, cant about 16 deg)
reference.notes: Conventional fuselage-mounted horizontal tail, underwing engines, no T-tail or aft engines. No E170 Airport Planning Manual could be retrieved (Embraer old URLs 404). Geometry is derived from the manufacturer E175 APM: E170 = E175 minus 0.84 m forward plug (wing and nacelle x shifted -0.84) and minus 0.94 m aft plug (tail x shifted a further -0.94, total -1.78). Wing, nacelle, fin and stabiliser shapes are identical between the two (stretch plugs only). Span 26.00 m is the E175 APM span over winglets for the standard (pre-SB 170-57-0058) wing; the 28.65 m extended-wingtip option is E175-only and not used. Height 9.86 m is the E175 APM value; secondary sources give 9.67 m (LOT table) and 9.85 m, so height is unresolved for the E170. Length 29.90 m from secondary sources (LOT, GE), equal to E175 31.68 minus 1.78. All shape values were measured off APM Fig 2.1, which is anisotropic (x 53.25 px/m, y 56.4 px/m at 400 dpi), so each axis was calibrated separately. v4: vtail.rootLEx confirmed as the fin proper (fin leading edge extended to the crown) on the APM side view; the dorsal fillet is separate (dorsalLength / dorsalHeight measured). Stabiliser rootY and tip anchors measured on the APM plan.

name: Embraer 195 (E1, ERJ-190-200)

reference.wingtip: Small blended winglet (tall, narrow, cant about 19 deg)
reference.notes: E1 E195, not the E2. Conventional fuselage-mounted horizontal tail and underwing engines. No E195 APM retrieved. Geometry derived from the manufacturer E190 APM (CF34-10E, same wing and engines as E195): E195 = E190 with wing and nacelle x shifted +0.81 m (plug A 2.41 to 3.22 m) and tail x shifted +2.43 m (plug B 3.7 to 5.31 m, +1.61 m more). Span 28.72 m over winglets and height 10.57 m are E190 APM figures; E195 secondary sources give 10.55 m height (APM 10.57 retained would be E190). Length 38.67 m is E190 36.24 plus 2.43; Skybrary gives 38.65. Shape values measured off APM Fig 2.1 (x 54.6 px/m, y 49.7 px/m at 400 dpi, calibrated per axis). Fuselage section 3.01 x 3.35 assumed equal to the E175 APM value. Nacelle is 2.19 wide by 1.84 high on the drawing; nacelleDiameter 2.0 is the mean. v4: vtail.rootLEx confirmed as the fin proper (fin leading edge extended to the crown) on the APM side view; the dorsal fillet is separate (dorsalLength / dorsalHeight measured). Stabiliser rootY and tip anchors measured on the APM plan.

name: Sukhoi Superjet 100 (SSJ100/95B, 95LR)

reference.wingtip: None (plain wingtip, 27.80 m span); sabrelet horizontal tip extension option gives 29.70 m and is not drawn
reference.notes: Conventional fuselage-mounted horizontal tail and underwing engines. UAC specifies span 27.80 m without GZK (horizontal wingtip extensions, sabrelets) and 29.70 m with them; length 29.94 m, height 10.28 m (UAC page and SuperJet International 2011 datasheet). The legacy fleet and photos show a plain wingtip with nav light, so the reference is 27.80 m with wingtip.type none. aircraft-top20 pairs 27.8 m with a blended winglet, which is inconsistent. Shape values measured off a UAC top-view render (17.43 px/m) and a three-view drawing (side 16.1 px/m, front 15.76 px/m), scaled by the 29.94 m length. Fuselage width measured about 3.45 m (top20 gives 3.46). No manufacturer drawing with dimension lines was found.

name: De Havilland Canada Dash 8 Series 200 (DHC-8-200)

reference.engine: Pratt & Whitney Canada PW123C/D with Hamilton Sundstrand 14SF-23 propellers
reference.notes: Series 200 (DHC-8-201/202), the ICAO DH8B type. High wing, T-tail, two turboprops. Primary sources: De Havilland Canada Q200 APM PSM 1-82-13 (Fig 2-3, 2-4) and EASA TCDS IM.A.191 Issue 16. APM: length 22.25, span 25.89, htail span 7.93, prop diameter 3.96 m (13 ft), fuselage width 2.69, fuselage height 2.57, engine y 3.94, prop plane 6.34 m from nose, fuselage end 20.78 m, fin top 7.47 m and fuselage top 3.17 m above ground (fin height above crown 4.30). TCDS: height 7.49. Wing, tail chords and nacelle shapes measured off the APM plan/side/front views (about 53 px/m front view). Small dorsal fillet at the fin leading edge is not modelled (dorsalFin false). Matches aircraft-top20 except it lacked a prop diameter. v3: fuselage.end added from the documented tail-cone end; tailconeLength shortened so the taper still starts at the same station.
